text: The web v0.717 Focus bar's hidden dead zone is 48, not the 24 the packet reports from the Android build. Displayed fill = (reload - 48) / (192 - 48), so the bar reads exactly zero precisely while reload <= 48, which is exactly when the stance change is refused: the bar and the CANNOT CHANGE STANCE gate are the same predicate. This is also the constant that makes the longplay measurement come out right — 44.7 px/s predicted vs 42.5 px/s measured, against 38.3 px/s from the Android-24 model.

lane_impact: L-combat-core / L-skills-meters: this is the mechanism behind 'OG has NO Critical meter (Focus buys evasion)' in the session-11 memory — the crit is bought by a FULL reload bar, and the stance mastery stats are damage multipliers, not cosmetic ranks.
quote: internal function getDamage() : int { var baseDamage:int = this.minDamage + Math.random() * this.damageRange; switch(this.stance) { case LIGHT_STANCE: maxDamage = baseDamage * (0.5 + 0.5 * this.lightMastery * 0.01); ... case HEAVY_STANCE: case DUAL_STANCE: case REVERSED_STANCE: maxDamage = baseDamage * 1.5; } if(this.reload == this.maxreload) { if(this.stance != LIGHT_STANCE) { return maxDamage * 1.2 + this.STAT_CRITICALDMG; } return maxDamage * 1.5 + this.STAT_CRITICALDMG; } return maxDamage; }
text: A full reload bar IS the crit condition, and stance mastery scales damage — neither is mentioned anywhere in the packet, which treats the bar purely as a slash budget. getDamage rolls baseDamage = minDamage + random()*damageRange, applies a stance factor (LIGHT x(0.5 + 0.5*lightMastery*0.01), BALANCED x(1 + 0.5*balancedMastery*0.01), HEAVY/DUAL/REVERSED x1.5), and then, only when reload == maxreload, returns maxDamage*1.2 + STAT_CRITICALDMG (x1.5 in LIGHT).

InputManager.setMaxDistance(this.slashLength);
text: Reach IS per-stance in the engine, closing the ledger blocker the packet's own claim #0 said was still open. MCSPlayer.setStance converts baseSlashLength (StatsManager.getBaseSlashLengthVal = 120 + floor((90 + DAN*5) * speed / (20 + speed))) into the live reach: LIGHT x1.5, BALANCED x(1 + 0.5*balancedMastery*0.01), HEAVY x(0.5 + 0.5*heavyMastery*0.01) floored at 100, REVERSED x1.5, DUAL x1 floored at 100 — then pushes it to InputManager.setMaxDistance. Note LIGHT carries no mastery term at all; lightMastery is spent on damage instead (MCSPlayer.as:3205).

text: The reload/Focus bar's maximum is a flat constant, not 48 + SPEED*6, and the two builds use DIFFERENT constants. StatsManager.getBaseReload() (48 + SPEED*6) is computed, passed into MCSPlayer.initPlayer and stored at :190 — and then never read anywhere in the bundle. :239 unconditionally sets maxreload = 5*24 = 120 (EnemyClone.as:77 does the same). The web v0.717 build sets 8*24 = 192. A recreation that scales the meter with SPEED is modelling something the original does not do.
